description: Coastal sea level rise, trends, to 2020 is a dataset listed in Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Reporting - Public. This data set measures the rise in annual mean sea level relative to land referenced to the latest Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) 1995 to 2014 baseline period mean sea level at four longer-term sites between 1901 and 2020: • Auckland • Wellington • Lyttelton • Dunedin and two additional sites with shorter time ... The portal shows 2023-12-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-mfe-portal.
